page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage options.

For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial processing power but do not demand massive memory footprints. This hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency by minimizing expenditures on unused memory and local storage resources.
The ecs.c9a.16xlarge is suited for workloads such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
